title: Tell your sister about your friend's family

scenario.en: Your friend Sara tells you about her family. Your sister wants to know how many people are in it.
scenario.ar: صاحبتك سارة حكتلك عن عيلتها. أختك عايزة تعرف هم كام واحد.

source: "I have got two brothers and one sister. My father is a teacher. My grandmother lives with us."

task.en: Tell your sister the important information about Sara's family.
task.ar: قول لأختك المعلومات المهمة عن عيلة سارة.

model_answer.en: Sara has got two brothers and one sister. Her father is a teacher, and her grandmother lives with them.
model_answer.ar: سارة عندها أخين وأخت واحدة. أبوها مدرّس، وجدتها ساكنة معاهم.
